bio.text: Marie Paule Woodson is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 105, first elected in 2020.
According to the House's biographical page, Woodson lives in Hollywood, is a public administrator, and chaired the Miami-Dade County Commission for Women from 2016 to 2018.
Woodson holds degrees from Miami-Dade College, Florida International University and St. Thomas University, was born in Port-de-Paix, Haiti, and moved to Florida in 1981.
